title: Deep Multivariate Models with Parametric Conditionals
abstract: arXiv:2602.01953v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: We consider deep multivariate models for heterogeneous collections of random variables. In the context of computer vision, such collections may e.g. consist of images, segmentations, image attributes, and latent variables. When developing such models, most existing works start from an application task and design the model components and their dependencies to meet the needs of the chosen task. This has the disadvantage of limiting the applicability of the resulting model for other downstream tasks. Here, instead, we propose to represent the joint probability distribution by means of conditional probability distributions for each group of variables conditioned on the rest. Such models can then be used for practically any possible downstream task. translated_title: 具有参数化条件分布的深度多元模型
translated_abstract: 我们研究面向异构随机变量集合的深度多元模型。在计算机视觉的背景下，此类集合可以由图像、分割结果、图像属性以及潜在变量等组成。在开发此类模型时，大多数现有工作从某个应用任务出发，设计模型组件及其依赖关系以满足所选任务的需求。这种做法的缺点是限制了所得模型在其他下游任务上的适用性。与此不同，我们提出用每组变量以其余变量为条件的条件概率分布来表示联合概率分布。这样构建的模型几乎可以用于任何可能的下游任务。此类模型的学习可以被看作训练一个参数化的马尔可夫链核，即通过最大化其极限分布的数据似然来进行训练。这还具有一个额外的好处，即允许……（原文摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 该论文提出用每组变量以其余变量为条件的参数化条件概率分布来表示联合概率分布，从而构建几乎可通用于任意下游任务的深度多元模型，其训练等价于通过最大化极限分布的数据似然来学习一个参数化马尔可夫链核。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes representing the joint probability distribution of heterogeneous variable collections via parametric conditional distributions of each variable group conditioned on the rest, enabling deep multivariate models applicable to virtually any downstream task, whose training amounts to learning a parametrized Markov chain kernel by maximizing the data likelihood of its limiting distribution.
